name: Rakuen ni Sumu Otoko -Man in the Garden of Eden-
original_name: 楽園に住む男-Man in the Garden of Eden-
source:
You are a private investigator tasked with what appears to be a mere case of marital infidelity.

While pursuing the shadow of a woman, you come across a variety of characters in a depraved city.

When the mystery eventually comes to light, you realize that nothing was what it seemed.
translation:
你是一名私家侦探，负责调查看似纯粹的婚姻不忠案件。

在追寻女人的影子时，你在堕落的城市中遇到了形形色色的人物。

当谜团最终揭开时，你会发现一切都不是表面看起来的那样。
